# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

completion:
Enter incident into **Workplace Recall** (NHS Lothian's incident reporting tool)
3. Complete the RIDDOR Audit Form and submit to the [contact list](https://www.example.com/contact-list)
4. Upload report to the intranet: [Incident Report Templates](https://www.example.com/incident-report-templates) for the safety focal point of your service

If it is the first reportable incident for your service:
- The safety focal point is responsible for the report

If it is not the first reportable accident for your service:
- We would expect for your service to handle this yourself.

However, if you need assistance please get in touch with the [contact list](https://www.example.com/contact-list).
